contrast_text.aci-rolling: ACI minus rolling window (negative = ACI better calibrated)
contrast_text.dracp-aci: DRACP minus ACI (negative = DRACP better calibrated)
contrast_text.aci-split: ACI minus one-shot split calibration (negative = ACI better calibrated)

headline: ACI is better calibrated than one-shot split calibration, consistently across panels and base models (secondary contrast, unadjusted).
ACI's advantage over a rolling window depends on the panel and the base model; where power is too low it is inconclusive.
DRACP versus ACI is inconclusive: the minimum detectable difference is undefined or above 7 pp.

chronos_accuracy.note: Clean target months only (from 2025-01); 30 countries; descriptive.

native_vs_aci.note: ARIMA base model. Native = Gaussian model-based interval; ACI = conformal. Secondary, unadjusted, post hoc.

commodity.criterion: UNCTAD: commodities >= 60% of allocated merchandise exports (3-year mean 2021-2023)
commodity.source: UNCTAD, The State of Commodity Dependence 2025 (UNCTAD/DITC/COM/2025/3)
commodity.note: Descriptive and post hoc. Three countries (Mexico, Indonesia, Georgia) do not reach 60%; with so few non-qualifying countries any comparison of the two groups is inconclusive.

v1.metrics: Pre-specified metrics (sign handling and keyword rules as first written)

v2.metrics: Post hoc corrected metrics (two metric defects fixed after the v1 results were seen)
